'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Kyle Krueger LS Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core|Ref3-L-nabootheedpalacegeneratorcore.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Kyle Krueser
* '''Username:''' meto
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
